mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_NO, O.ORDER_DT, O.ORDER_STAT_CD, U.USER_NM, O.TOT_AMT FROM TB_ORDER O JOIN TB_USER U ON O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} AND ROWNUM <= 1000
SELECT I.*, G.GOODS_NM FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM I JOIN TB_GOODS G ON I.GOODS_NO = G.GOODS_NO WHERE I.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER SET ORDER_STAT_CD = #{orderStatCd} WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ORDER_HIST (HIST_SN, ORDER_NO, ORDER_STAT_CD, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_ORDER_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo}, #{orderStatCd}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER_DLVY SET DLVY_STAT_CD = #{dlvyStatCd}, INVOICE_NO = #{invoiceNo} WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
mapper.select: SELECT D.ORDER_NO, D.DLVY_STAT_CD, D.INVOICE_NO, O.USER_ID FROM TB_ORDER_DLVY D JOIN TB_ORDER O ON D.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO
SELECT C.CLAIM_NO, C.ORDER_NO, C.CLAIM_TY_CD, C.CLAIM_STAT_CD FROM TB_ORDER_CLAIM C
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ORDER_CLAIM (CLAIM_NO, ORDER_NO, CLAIM_TY_CD, CLAIM_STAT_CD) VALUES (#{claimNo}, #{orderNo}, #{claimTyCd}, 'REQ')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER_CLAIM SET CLAIM_STAT_CD = #{claimStatCd} WHERE CLAIM_NO = #{claimNo}
mapper.select: SELECT HIST_SN, ORDER_STAT_CD, REG_DT FROM TB_ORDER_HIST WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ORDER BY HIST_SN DESC
